title: Songs on the 1970 album: 'They All Laughed' and 'He's Funny That Way'
summary: She explains choosing old songs, 'They All Laughed' from her early Onyx Club days, and running out of material.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: And one of the funny things that had occurred there in 1970, a woman came to Earl and said, 'I remember seeing your father way back in the forties.'
It wasn't Earl's father, it was Earl

"I've Got The World On A String," "A Hundred Years From Today," and "The Ace In The Hole." That's a real old -- what do you call -- cabaret song.
And you hadn't recorded that one before.
No, I hadn't recorded that before.
Of course, "He's Funny That Way," which is a very good oldie. I --

I do "They All Laughed" sort of tongue-in-cheek because "They All Laughed" is a little vintage and so was my repertoire; so we keep it, everything in the context of the Thirties. I mean early Thirties.
"They All Laughed" was in my repertoire when I first came to the Onyx Club when I was singing during the intermission with Jennie Dillard.
We were doing what was currently popular in those days. But these are good songs.

That's right. We also have information based on the letter that I received from Johnson McRee, that you made one more title, this being committed to record from the December 6, 1970 Manassas jazz festival. This is by the same group that performed 'Georgia On My Mind' on the album entitled 'Queen of Song,' which we discussed earlier. There's another Fat Cat album which I don't have a title, but the number is FCJ126, and a performance of The 'St. Louis Blues.' Not the one we discussed earlier, but a different one is issued on an album with other material. Since neither of us have heard this performance, there's not much we can say about it.
Well I think that this is an indication that I've run out on material for Fat Cat records since we're down to 'St. Louis Blues' -- one song.
I imagine that's on an album that has performances by other artists -- other musicians.
